capabilities.applied_behavior: Resolves text geometry from declared visual target, attachment, path position, orientation, and offset while preserving native text objects.
capabilities.fallback_behavior: Only an explicit use_declared_zone fallback is permitted and is recorded as a warning.
capabilities.warning_behavior: Missing targets, unsupported attachment/orientation, and explicit fallback are written to runtime evidence.
known_limitations: PowerPoint text remains horizontal by default; tangent/normal records rotation rather than curved glyph layout.

capabilities.applied_behavior: Writes one a:alpha node to an existing solid DrawingML fill.
capabilities.warning_behavior: Reports unsupported when no solid fill is available.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: The requested field is recorded in composition_runtime_report.
known_limitations: Gradient and picture fills are not supported.

capabilities.applied_behavior: Writes one a:alpha node to an existing solid DrawingML line.
capabilities.warning_behavior: Reports unsupported if the line cannot be represented as a solid DrawingML color.
known_limitations: Theme-native transparency is only supported after the color resolves to a solid color.

capabilities.applied_behavior: Writes one a:alpha node to each affected text run after its solid color is resolved.
capabilities.warning_behavior: Reports unsupported if no solid text color is available.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: No font opacity is silently applied.
known_limitations: Theme inheritance without a resolvable color is not supported.

capabilities.applied_behavior: Applies alpha to explicitly requested solid textbox fill and/or line.
capabilities.warning_behavior: Reports unsupported when neither a fill nor stroke exists.
known_limitations: Text glyph opacity is configured separately.

capabilities.fallback_behavior: Keep the image at its source alpha only.
capabilities.warning_behavior: Adds an explicit warning and unsupported_fields entry.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Assembly never silently ignores a requested raster opacity.
known_limitations: Source PNG alpha remains supported; runtime alpha multiplication is not.

capabilities.applied_behavior: Preserves source PNG alpha while fitting or cropping the placed image.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Raster image opacity remains separately unsupported.

capabilities.fallback_behavior: Apply opacity per supported child only when explicitly modeled.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: No group-level XML patch is attempted.
known_limitations: No safe group-level alpha multiplication in this runtime.

capabilities.applied_behavior: Applies alpha after a runtime color token resolves to a solid RGB color.
capabilities.warning_behavior: Unresolved inherited theme colors are reported as unsupported.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: No direct mutation of theme definitions.
known_limitations: Direct inherited theme-color alpha is not supported.

capabilities.applied_behavior: Creates non-enforcing review material from existing runtime evidence.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: No automatic visual binding decision is made.
